text.ms:
1. Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Rumah

Penyembelihan (Fi Pelesenan) 2013.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna yang

lain—

"pihak berkuasa veterinar" mempunyai erti yang sama yang diberikan

kepadanya oleh Akta Binatang 1953 [Akta 647].

Fi

3. (1) Fi yang dikenakan bagi lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah seksyen 3 Akta

adalah sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual.

(2) Fi yang disebut dalam subkaedah (1) hendaklah dibayar kepada pihak

berkuasa veterinar melalui apa-apa kaedah dan mengikut apa-apa cara yang ditentukan

oleh Ketua Pengarah.

JADUAL

[Subkaedah 3(1)]

FI BAGI LESEN MENJALANKAN RUMAH PENYEMBELIHAN

Fi permohonan RM100 setiap permohonan

Fi tahunan RM300 setiap lesen

Fi bagi menggantikan lesen hilang atau rosak RM100 setiap lesen

Fi lewat membaharui lesen RM1,000 setiap lesen

Dibuat 18 November 2013

[KP/LA/483/15; PN(PU2)534]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Menteri Pertanian dan Industri Asas Tani

ABATTOIRS (PRIVATIZATION) ACT 1993

ABATTOIRS (LICENSING FEES) RULES 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 11(2)(f) of the

Abattoirs (Privatization) Act 1993 [Act 507], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation

1. These rules may be cited as the Abattoirs (Licensing Fees) Rules 2013.

Interpretation

2. In these Rules, unless the context otherwise requires—

 "veterinary authority" has the same meaning assigned to it by the Animals

Act 1953 [Act 647].

Fees

3. (1) The fee imposed for a licence issued under section 3 of the Act shall be as

prescribed in the Schedule.

(2) The fee referred to in subrule (1) shall be paid to the veterinary authority

by such means and in such manner as determined by the Director General.

SCHEDULE

[Subrule 3(1)]

FEES FOR A LICENCE TO OPERATE AN ABATTOIR

Application fee RM100 per application

Annual fee RM300 per licence

Fee for replacement of lost or damaged licence RM100 per licence

Fee for late renewal RM1,000 per licence

Made 18 November 2013

[KP/LA/483/15; PN(PU2)534]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Minister of Agriculture and Agro-based Industry
